name: sqlite-format-v1
sampling: Source-order equally spaced eligible indexes, endpoints included; separate changed/identical-history strata; no random or loss-based sample choice.
target_rule: Literal source-aligned ASCII letters inside paragraph text, outside tcl/script/style/pre/code; transformed entity and synthesized bytes never targets.
projection: Conservative HTML-like prose rendering: strip tags/comments and tcl/script/style/pre/code spans; decode character entities; collapse ASCII whitespace; insert block/drop-boundary spaces. Preserve SQLite bracket/caret macros. Not the official SQLite renderer.
intervention: For the identical literal target byte, replace its immediately preceding 64 raw source bytes with immediately preceding 64 projected bytes. Same byte budget, not the same underlying source/prose span. Score only the final target, independently of prior block boundaries.
primary: Projected minus raw mean next-byte NLL in sampled changed-history pairs; report per document, each seed/arm and paired seeds.
control: Identical-history stratum: exact same targets and inputs must give equal scores.
no_tuning: Original six selected checkpoint tensors fixed; all original artifacts immutable; no training/selection on SQLite; reconstruction is recovery only. No extraction or sample revisions after scoring. Descriptive n=3, no significance or population claims.
